definitions.explanation: The authority or power to govern a country or region. Also used to refer to a specific administration or government in power.

examples.japanese: {政権|せいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧{政権|せいけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The current administration is pushing forward economic reforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{政権|せいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}そう⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition party is trying to reclaim power in the next election.

notes:
USAGE:
A central term in political news and discourse. Can refer abstractly to political power itself or concretely to a specific administration (e.g., {安倍|あべ}{政権|せいけん}, the Abe administration). Frequently appears in news headlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政権|せいけん}⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: change of government
- {政権|せいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to hold power, to be in power
- {政権|せいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take power
- ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧{政権|せいけん}: the current administration
- {連立|れんりつ}{政権|せいけん}: coalition government

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧: government (the institution/organization)
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧: cabinet (the prime minister and ministers)
